description: This Java source file defines a class `MonkeyGetFrameRateEvent` used in the Android testing framework to measure and log the frame rate of the system's rendering by executing a shell command. It includes methods for parsing command output, calculating average frame rate, and writing results to a file.

classes.name: MonkeyGetFrameRateEvent
classes.description: A class for capturing and calculating the system's frame rendering rate during a test event.

methods.name: getAverageFrameRate
methods.description: Calculates the average frame rate given total number of frames and duration.

methods.name: writeAverageFrameRate
methods.description: Calculates and writes the average frame rate to a log file.

methods.name: getNumberOfFrames
methods.description: Extracts the number of frames from the command output using regex.

methods.name: injectEvent
methods.description: Executes the shell command to get frame rate info, parses the output, and updates frame count and timing.
